public_payload.normalized_proposition: There is not 5GW of capacity for Anthropic to buy now, nor will there be 10GW more for it to buy in 2027.

statement.excerpt: There is not 5GW of capacity for Anthropic to buy, nor will there be 10GW more for it to buy in 2027, and to suggest otherwise is to further perpetuate myths about how fast compute comes online and Anthropic’s ability to pay for it.

from_speaker: There is not 5GW of capacity for Anthropic to buy
our_interpretation: This combines a present observation with a forecast. The present clause refers to September 22, 2026; the surrounding paragraph also permits an end-2026 reading.
Capacity means powered, commissioned AI compute capacity that Anthropic can actually procure and use, rather than proposed construction or a contract for future delivery.
The 2027 clause concerns an additional 10GW becoming available during that calendar year, without counting the same capacity twice.
The threshold concerns availability to Anthropic, not necessarily capacity that Anthropic ultimately purchases.
criteria.support_condition: A sufficiently complete inventory establishes less than 5GW available at publication and, after 2027 ends, less than 10GW of additional eligible capacity becoming available during 2027.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Verified operational and procurement records establish at least 5GW available at publication, or at least 10GW of additional eligible capacity becoming available during 2027. If only one component fails, preserve the separate finding on the other component.

evidence.explanation: The announcement describes phased future delivery under an agreement for up to 5GW. It does not establish 5GW already available to Anthropic or determine how much additional capacity will become available during 2027.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A dated inventory of operating capacity available to Anthropic at publication, followed by commissioning and procurement records covering additional capacity delivered throughout 2027, using a consistent GW definition.
